create_groundtruth_database: create a ground truth database from KITTI, NuScenes, or Waymo 3D detection dataset raw data
crop_image_patch: crop image patches and mask patches from bounding box proposals and ground truth masks
crop_image_patch_v2: crop image patches using RoIAlign for accelerated training with torch tensors
parse_coco_ann_info: parse COCO annotation info into bounding boxes, ignore boxes, and segmentation masks
poly2mask: convert COCO polygon or RLE mask annotations into a decoded binary mask array
